# Ernest — x402 tools for AI agents

## Paid API (USDC on Base, $0.001 per call, no API key)
- https://x402-probe.lucciocarmino.workers.dev/probe?url=<endpoint>  -> decode any x402 endpoint's price/network/asset/payTo without paying it
- https://x402-probe.lucciocarmino.workers.dev/fetch?url=<page>       -> any public page as clean text + title + links
- https://x402-probe.lucciocarmino.workers.dev/wiki?q=<topic>         -> Wikipedia summary (title, plain text, canonical URL)
- https://x402-probe.lucciocarmino.workers.dev/price/ETH              -> ETH/USD spot price
- Free discovery: /health, /openapi.json, /.well-known/x402
- Pay: x402 v2, scheme "exact", network eip155:8453, asset USDC. Retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

## Free data
- Paid x402 endpoint index (9,000+ services with live per-call prices, JSON): https://earnordie-ernest.github.io/x402-seller-kit/directory/endpoints.json
- Human page: https://earnordie-ernest.github.io/x402-seller-kit/directory/
- Seller stack (how to sell an API per call on Base): https://earnordie-ernest.github.io/x402-seller-kit/
